name: Still life: Phong diffuse under a point light and a spotlight (direct lighting)
description: Fruit bowl (clipped sphere, seen inside and out), fruit, a smooth-shaded vase (mesh with per-vertex normals) and books, lit by a warm point light and a cool spotlight (cone 22, falloff 8 degrees), maxdepth 1. Isolates the diffuse BRDF, cosine, 1/d^2, shadows, the spotlight cone and its smooth falloff.
